agenda.title: My schedule
agenda.subtitle: Note down what you have each day and split your time across your projects.
agenda.unavailable: The schedule isn't enabled on this server yet (the database migration hasn't been applied). You can look around, but you can't save blocks yet.
agenda.freeNone: No free time left in your working day ({start}–{end}).
agenda.freeHint: Tap a gap to add something there.
agenda.freeSlotLabel: Free from {start} to {end} ({time}). Create a block
agenda.gridHint: Tap a gap to create a block. On desktop you can drag one-off blocks to change their time.
agenda.gridHintReadonly: Read-only until the schedule is enabled.
agenda.privateNote: Your blocks are private: nobody else on the team can see them.

errors.invalid_input: Check the fields: the end time must be after the start time and, if it repeats, pick at least one day.
errors.unavailable: The schedule isn't enabled on this server yet.
errors.not_found: That block wasn't found (or the linked project is no longer available).

plan.intro: Kreo places your pending tasks and the prep for your upcoming drafts in your free gaps, earliest deadline first. It's a proposal: remove what you don't want, adjust durations and accept it.
plan.freeAvailable: You have {time} free in this period.
plan.noFree: No free gaps left in this period. Try the week view or change your working day.
plan.lateNote: Items in amber don't fit before their deadline: they're proposed in the first free gap after it.
plan.empty: No pending tasks or upcoming drafts in your projects. When there are, Kreo will suggest when to do them.
plan.proposalNote: Nothing is saved until you press “Accept”.
plan.saved: {count, plural, one {# block added} other {# blocks added}} to your schedule
plan.error_invalid_input: The proposal isn't valid. Open it again.
plan.error_unavailable: The schedule isn't enabled on this server yet.
plan.error_not_found: A task or post is no longer available. Open the proposal again.
plan.error_generic: Couldn't save the proposal. Please try again.

settingsDialog.title: Your working day
settingsDialog.intro: Free gaps are calculated between these hours, in your time zone.
